name: Dragon, Harmonic
body:
HARMONIC DRAGON, VERY YOUNG
CR 4

This multi-colored dragon’s wings display mesmerizing complexity, and her voice is as beautiful as it is powerful.

XP 1,200
CG Small dragon (sonic)
Init +6; Senses dragon senses; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural, +1 size)
hp 37 (5d12+5)
Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +4
Immune sonic, paralysis, sleep
Weaknesses Vulnerability to acid

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +7 (1d6+1), 2 claws +7 (1d4+1)
Special Attacks bardic performance 14 rounds/day (inspire courage +2), breath weapon (20-ft. cone, DC 13, 4d4 sonic, once per 1d4 rounds)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +7)

At-will— ghost sound (DC 12)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 13, Wis 10, Cha 15
Base Atk +5; CMB +5; CMD 17 (21 vs. trip)
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Bluff)
Skills Bluff +13, Diplomacy +10, Fly +10, Intimidate +10, Knowledge (nobility) +9, Perform (sing) +7, Sleight of Hand +6, Stealth +6
Languages Draconic, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bardic Performance (Su)

A very young harmonic dragon can inspire courage with his song as a 5th level bard using bardic performance. Starting inspire courage is a standard action, but it can be maintained each round as a free action. Inspire courage provides allies within 30 feet with a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against charm and fear effects and a +2 competence bonus on attack and weapon damage rolls. It may use inspire courage for 14 rounds per day.

Dragon Senses (Ex)

Dragons have darkvision 120 ft. and blindsense 60 ft. They see four times as well as a human in dim light and twice as well in normal light.
